answer: You may have used the right idea in the wrong mode: press T, make sure DO is lit red, then enter the fire-making words. Keep the flint and steel file low over the dry grass, and blow on the sparks; the bar should tell us if something else is wrong.

You may have tried to make a bow, but the grass has no spring—so it can’t launch anything. For the fire, pick up the flint shard and use the dry grass as tinder; hold the flint low over it and strike it against the steel file, then blow on the sparks.
The dry grass has no spring—it bends and stays bent, so it can’t make a bow. Try the flint and file low over the grass, then blow on the sparks; make sure DO is lit when you enter the action.
